**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Healthcare and Industrials also showing leadership: JNJ (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND and APD (1W: +10.61% | 1M: +10.55%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Financials and Healthcare exposure (JPM ABOVE TREND, JNJ ABOVE TREND, LLY ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to names showing structural 1M weakness despite short-term 1W pops (ORCL (1W: -9.54% | 1M: -42.58%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given narrow Tech concentration and major cap divergence.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND for failure to reclaim its 1M downtrend as a trigger for broader Tech risk; watch AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -3.89%) RECOVERY for confirmation above recent 1W strength; watch JPM (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +12.64%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above the 1M trend as signal of cyclical follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. PANW (1W: +23.41% | 1M: +17.16%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +13.25% | 1M: +2.27%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.63%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among megacaps (MSFT, AAPL, GOOGL showing 1W vs 1M splits) and narrow Tech concentration in leadership—monitor for trend breaks and news-confirmed follow-through.
